sections.title: Added
items: Unified Kit V2 components for upcoming screen redesigns: Hero, ProgressBar, ActionTile, ChoiceCard, OptionTiles, Stepper, StepperRow, NoticeBlock, Pill tones, DateTile, Sheet subtitle, and SummaryCallout (MKL-86).
Unified multi-step modal wizard frame (ModalWizard) shared by New Account and New Planned Payment (MKL-85).

sections.title: Changed
items: Retired Banner across Draft review, SplitPager, and Cash count, showing sync errors as a status row in Details and stale counts via NoticeBlock (MKL-84).
Enforced architectural lint rules preventing raw touch/input primitives and direct database queries in screen components (MKL-87).

sections.title: Settings
items: Settings is regrouped with clearer names (Accounts, Loans and debts, Payee nicknames, Subscriptions and recurring, Lock the app) and shows how many of each you have (MKL-89).
Receipt reading settings updated to board 27 with masked API key, "Where it runs" live reachability status, and a "Test both now" reader check (MKL-90).

Your Firefly III updated to board 29 with an in-card connection status and actions, inline addresses with live reachability and "Test all", a masked access token, and a persistent sign-out row (MKL-92).

sections.title: Count cash
items: Cash sweep shortfall and surplus pickers updated to board 28 Choose sheet with "Used this year" filter and deduplicated across Count cash and Settings (MKL-91).
